settings.title: Artifact size
settings.summary: The largest one version of an artifact may be.
settings.description: The largest one version of an artifact may be, in bytes. A model that writes a larger one is told so and nothing is kept.

settings.title: Artifact versions kept
settings.summary: How many versions of an artifact are kept; zero keeps all.
settings.description: How many of an artifact's newest versions are kept. Zero keeps every version. When a new version would pass the number, the oldest is removed, and the newest is never removed.

settings.title: Artifact title length
settings.summary: The longest title an artifact may have.
settings.description: The most characters an artifact's title may have.

settings.title: Artifact permissions
settings.summary: What an artifact is allowed to do inside its frame.
settings.description: What an artifact's sandboxed frame may do, as sandbox permissions separated by spaces, from allow-scripts, allow-forms, allow-modals, allow-downloads and allow-pointer-lock. Same-origin, top navigation and popups are never allowed, whatever this says. Without allow-scripts, HTML runs no script and React and Mermaid artifacts are not drawn.
